notes: All samples carry pALA3047 (Plac-cfp-ParB) as a labelling tool and IPTG is in the medium: genotype_class reference, inducer_added true. Lysogens (prophage lambda) are not reference: genotype_class, growth_phase left out. ch:strain MG1656..MG1662 are typos for MG1655 (organism field). mixed_organism left out for infected samples (phage RNA). Infected samples: phage, acute <=20 min (0+ included), short at 45/60 min; growth_phase mid_exponential inferred from OD 0.4 pre-infection (all <2 h). Uninfected hosts are the controls; no mock-infected samples in the table.
